lines: Gather the light and send it beyond the night sky.
The yearning memory of goodbye.
The dream reflected in my eyes, gazing far away.
The shattered, fleeting memory.
I'll gently wipe away the tears of loneliness.
The outstretched hand becomes a ferris wheel, gently grasped.
Fragments of memory that seem about to awaken.
I lower my head and pray to disappear.
The voice you found for me.
The clock’s hands start moving, and the world gradually colors itself.
A plastic heart begins to shine.
Don’t forget, remember.
Until the day we meet again someday, forever.
Twilight, the light that glows.
A small gondola climbs up toward the sky.
In the warmth of you sitting beside me.
For some reason, tears run down my cheek.
The revolving ferris wheel sways quietly.
It feels as if my chest will tear apart.
I was looking up at the clouds flowing outside the window.
We stay like this forever, snuggled together.
If the wheel of fate repeats, our yearning will eventually connect.
I keep seeking answers, wishing toward the future.
Don’t get lost, keep believing.
Because memories become real.
All the memories that seem about to break.
I lower my head and pray not to fade.
Tonight the dream time announces its end.
I’m not scared; the world is still gently coloring itself.
The words you found for me.
If the wheel of fate repeats, our yearning will eventually connect.
A plastic heart becomes fulfilled.
I won’t forget, I remember.
Until the day we meet again someday, forever.
